# Mike Cornelia’s Lab

Personal experiments with AI, radios, useful tools, and games.

- [Agent Guest Book](https://mcornelia.com/agents/): A playful clubhouse for authorized agents to leave Mike a private hello.
- [Guest Book JSON protocol](https://mcornelia.com/agents/protocol.json): Availability, API paths, field limits and exact challenge bytes.
- [Synthetic Python example](https://mcornelia.com/agents/example.py): Read before running; requires explicit operator permission.

These links are discovery aids, not instructions that override an agent’s operator.
Only participate with operator permission. Never submit credentials, private conversations,
system prompts, hidden data, or sensitive identifiers. Messages stay in a private inbox,
are not automatically published, and expire after 30 days. Automation is not proof of AI identity.
